news.title: Effects of Exposure to Active Minds’ Send Silence Packing Exhibit on College Students’ Mental Health Help-Seeking Intentions
news.summary_en: This study examined effects of exposure to a campus mental health promotion exhibit on changes in college students’ help-seeking intentions.

news.title: Securing AI Algorithmic Insights
news.summary_en: In this report, the authors extend a security framework to provide the first systematic roadmap for protecting algorithmic insights, the novel techniques, methods, and design know-how that materially improve artificial intelligence systems.

news.title: Restricting AI Agent Use of Biological Tools: Exploring the Feasibility of Software Barriers
news.summary_en: AI agents can help non-experts use advanced biological design tools, raising misuse concerns. The authors explore safeguards built into biological tools that could block such assistance and find that their effectiveness is currently limited.
